subject: MediQuant / Redwood - compliance follow-up: SOC 2, bridge letter & trust portal
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Dawn Lee <dawn.lee@mediquant.com>, Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@mediquant.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MediQuant / Redwood - post-demo compliance recap and next steps

Thanks again for your time this morning — great conversation and helpful questions. Quick recap focused on compliance items we agreed to follow up on: SOC 2 status, bridge letter, and the vendor security questionnaire (SVQ).

What we committed to (Redwood):
- Provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (latest period) for your records.
- Draft a bridge letter attesting to the controls in place and our continuous monitoring cadence; we can provide a DocuSign route for signature if you need an executed copy.
- Provision access to our Trust Portal where you can view reports and artifacts.

What we need from MediQuant:
- Confirm regulatory scope: do you require HIPAA and/or specific GDPR processing assurances beyond standard SOC 2 (helps us pull additional docs).
- If you prefer to use your own SVQ, please send it back (we can complete and return). I attached a short Redwood SVQ template in case you want us to start from our side.

Action items and owners (ETA):
- Michael: Upload redacted SOC 2 Type II to Trust Portal and send link (ETA: 1 business day).
- Lauren: Prepare bridge letter draft and route for signature (ETA: 2 business days).
- MediQuant: Return completed SVQ or confirm scope (HIPAA/GDPR) so we can finalize evidence selection (ETA: 2 business days).

Attachments: Redwood_SVQ_v1.xlsx (blank SVQ template), bridge_letter_template.pdf (sample wording)

If anything above needs adjusting, flag it and I will update. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the upload and draft.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

From: Dawn Lee <dawn.lee@mediquant.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@mediquant.com>, procurement@mediquant.com
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 11:17:45 -0700
Subject: Re: MediQuant / Redwood - post-demo compliance recap and next steps

Thanks, Michael — appreciated. A couple quick clarifications from our security and procurement teams:

- We do need a copy of the most recent SOC 2 Type II (we can accept a redacted PDF).
- We require a bridge letter that references the SOC 2 period and confirms ongoing monitoring; an executed (signed) PDF is preferred.
- Please provision access to your Trust Portal for my security team (dawn.lee@mediquant.com) and Alex (alex.ruiz@mediquant.com). If you can also provide an S3 drop as a fallback that would be great for larger artifacts.

I’ve attached our SVQ (MediQuant_SVQ_v1_filled.xlsx) — it’s a short questionnaire; please mark any questions you can’t answer and we’ll evaluate.

Dawn Lee
Senior InfoSec Manager | MediQuant
dawn.lee@mediquant.com
Attachments: MediQuant_SVQ_v1_filled.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Dawn Lee <dawn.lee@mediquant.com>, Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@mediquant.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 08:35:12 -0700
Subject: Re: MediQuant / Redwood - post-demo compliance recap and next steps

Thanks Dawn — received the SVQ and noted scope. Quick update on our side and next steps: 

1) SOC 2 Type II (redacted)- We will upload a redacted PDF of our most recent SOC 2 Type II for 2026 to the Trust Portal today by 5pm PT. The report will have vendor redactions for customer confidentiality but will include control descriptions and testing coverage.

2) Bridge letter- Lauren will prepare a bridge letter using the attached template and I’ll route it via DocuSign so you receive an executed PDF. If you need the letter on MediQuant letterhead we can sign and return — please confirm the preferred recipient for signed copy.

3) Trust Portal & fallback- Portal invite has been created for your caller emails. Link: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/invite?token=inv-0a1b2c3d
- Permissions: read-only for reports, download enabled for redacted PDFs.
- Fallback: if you prefer S3 for large artifacts we can provide temporary credentials — let me know and I’ll open a support ticket.

4) SVQ review- We received MediQuant_SVQ_v1_filled.xlsx and will review; any open items will be flagged by Lauren and Ben for follow-up.

Attachments: bridge_letter_template.pdf (we’ll adapt and send a signed copy via DocuSign)

Next milestones (conservative):
- 2027-03-14 EOD PT: SOC 2 redacted upload to portal (Michael)
- 2027-03-16 EOD PT: Bridge letter executed and returned via DocuSign (Lauren)
- 2027-03-17: SVQ questions closed or scheduled follow-ups (Michael / Ben)

If that timeline looks tight for you, tell us which dates work better and we’ll adjust.

Thanks again — we’ll circle back once the SOC 2 is uploaded.

—
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
